ambient_trade.text: Dyed wool out of {town} fetching {gold} a bale this week, and salt is holding steady. Who needs a caravan?
Paying {gold} a sack for salt in {town} today. Name your route and I will name my price.
Anyone selling good dyed cloth out of {town}? I will take the lot at {gold} if the quality holds up.
Wool in {town} sits at {gold} a bale right now, which is robbery for buyers and fair for sellers. Who is hauling south?

encounter_trade_offer.text: Ser {player}, I have no love for you, but a deal is a deal. You offer {gold} for safe passage through {town}? Let us talk prices.
Ser {player}, a bold offer. {gold} for passage out of {town} is not bad, but I want salt thrown in as well.
Hear me out, Ser {player}. Pay {gold} and I will haul your goods out of {town} without losing a single bale.
{player}, you always find me in a good mood. Knock {gold} off the price and the salt wagon is yours to haul out of {town}.

encounter_greeting.text: Ser {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} here. Keep your blades sheathed and we might still earn something from this meeting.
Where are you headed, Ser {player}? I am {persona} of {my_faction}, and I can name you a fair price on the road ahead.
Good day, Ser {player}. {persona} of {my_faction}, hauling wool and salt. Tell me your route and we can see what it is worth.
Ser {player}! {persona} of {my_faction}, and I am glad to see a friendly face on this muddy road. Care to share a fire and a deal?

player_raided_my_village.text: Burning {village} is bad for business, {player}. Half the wool road is empty now and I lose coin every day it stays that way.
Word is {village} went up in smoke. Raids like that scare off caravans, and scared caravans mean higher tolls for all of us.
Ser {player}, {village} was burned and my wool merchants are running scared. I will still talk if you name a fair price for peace.
Ser {player}, you have made {village} a poor place to buy salt. Give me a reason to think you will stop and I will forget the prices.

war_declared.text: War between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}? Every road will be a toll gate by spring. Terrible news for anyone holding wool.
{my_faction} has declared on {enemy_faction}. Roads are about to get expensive and my wool is stuck in the warehouse.
Fine, {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} want their war. I will haul salt for both sides at double the usual rate.

peace_made.text: Peace between {my_faction} and {faction} at last. The roads will reopen and my wool wagons can stop taking the long way.
{my_faction} made peace with {faction}. Prices will drop for a season, so buy low while the lords sort out their quarrels.
Good news for trade: {my_faction} and {faction} are at peace. I am already pricing the route through their lands.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player} let me walk free rather than pay ransom. That is a deal I will remember, and my ledger has a fresh line for you.
Ser {player}, thank you for releasing me. I always settle my debts, so let us make a fair deal to square things.
Ser {player} released me without ransom, which I did not expect. I still count the wool I lost, but I will not forget the favor.
Ser {player}, you let me go with my coin and my pride intact. Ask me for salt or a fair price on the road back anytime.

beat_by_player.text: Lost {troop_count} troops to {player} in the field. Costly, and the wool road now needs guards I cannot afford.
Ser {player}, you took {troop_count} of my men at the field. I am not angry, just counting coins for replacements.
Ser {player}, you beat {troop_count} of my men fair and square. That is not cheap for me, but I respect a sharp blade and a sharp bargain.
Ser {player}, you have cost me {troop_count} men in the field. Pay the damages and we can talk business again.

whisper_beg_help.text: Ser {player}, {enemy_faction} is at the gates of {fief} and my wool stores are inside. I will pay in salt and coin if you can spare men.
Ser {player}, we are losing the war for {fief} to {enemy_faction}. Help me hold that road and I will share the profits fairly.
Dear friend {player}, {fief} is in danger and I cannot ride to it myself. Send some of your men and I will give you my best salt price.
{player}, {enemy_faction} has the road to {fief} cut off. Come quickly and I will offer coin, goods or a lifetime of discounts.

ambient_complaint.text: Bandits on the {town} road took another cart of dyed wool. Guards are a waste of coin unless someone pays them well.
Tolls at {town} are up again and no one asked the merchants. {faction} has forgotten that roads feed their own treasury.
{rival} is undercutting everyone on salt. Good for buyers, rotten for those of us who actually haul the stuff.
Another ambush outside {town} and my prices go up whether the lords like it or not. Honest travelers pay for others' mess.

ambient_chatter.text: Rain again on the {town} road. Mud slows the wagons and the wool gets soaked. Lovely weather for a bad temper.
Anyone else lagging near {village}? Caravan timers are off by a day and my ledger is a mess.
Good road weather at last. I have figures for every road between here and the coast if anyone wants them.
Heard a bard in {village} singing about a merchant who won a horse at dice. Sounds like a story I would not believe xD
